title: Tech view: the user can add new work order lines but cannot edit existing ones
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with View mode set to Tech view and Work order lines View and Create & Edit.
custom_steps:
1. Open a work order that already has lines.
  2. Try to edit an existing line.
  3. Try to add a new line.
custom_expected:
The existing line is read-only.

A new line can be added.
evidence: UI (Technician tech view): New Line is present (can add lines); an existing APPROVED line is read-only (clicking it adds no editable inputs), while the user can still add new lines. Existing authorized lines read-only + add-new works. screenshot approved-line-readonly.
